rules.statement: A sale in execution under a decree upon a primary mortgage shifts the right created by other mortgages from the land to the proceeds of sale left over after the satisfaction of the claim of the primary mortgagee.
rules.supporting_quote: "It follows, therefore, that the title to a land sold in execution of the decree upon a primary mortgage passes to the purchaser free of any encumbrance created by a secondary mortgage or any such encumbrance."
